segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ בּוֹר שֶׁל יָחִיד — כְּרַגְלֵי הַיָּחִיד, וְשֶׁל אַנְשֵׁי אוֹתָהּ הָעִיר — כְּרַגְלֵי אַנְשֵׁי אוֹתָהּ הָעִיר, וְשֶׁל עוֹלֵי בָבֶל — כְּרַגְלֵי הַמְמַלֵּא.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» With regard to «a cistern of an individual,» water drawn from it «is as the feet of the individual» who owns the cistern, and the water may be carried only to those places where its owner is permitted to walk. «And» water drawn from a cistern belonging jointly to all «the people» dwelling in «a particular town is as the feet of the people of that town. And» water drawn from a cistern «of those who come up» to Eretz Yisrael «from Babylonia,» i.e., a public cistern, is «as the feet of whoever fills» his vessel with its water; the water has no defined boundary of its own since it is made available to all.

moves.summary: water follows the cistern's owners; a public cistern follows the drawer

positions.claim: water of an individual's cistern follows him; of a town's, the townspeople; of a public cistern, the one who draws
